_what: The 2020-census population and deviation the ENACTED Nebraska plan prints for each district of each board. Read by eye from the Legislative Research Office's official per-district map sheets, which are raster PDFs with no text layer. Each loader checks the ArcGIS layer's POPULATION attribute against the number here, exactly.
_why: Nebraska's three boards are redistricted BY MAP REFERENCE (LB 5, LB 7, LB 8 of the 2021 First Special Session name no county), so the usual statute gate does not exist. The county composition comes from the Secretary of State's canvass books (parse-ne-canvass-counties.mjs); this file is the SECOND anchor, and it is the only one that can tell two districts apart when their county sets are identical. State Board of Education 4 and 8 both lie wholly inside Douglas County, as do Regents 4 and 8: the canvass cannot separate either pair, and these populations can.
_how_to_re_check: Open the PDF named in `sheets` below, go to the page for the district, and read the 'District N Statistics' box: the Population and % Deviation rows. The numbers were transcribed by hand; the loaders compare them to the GIS attribute exactly, so a transcription slip fails the gate rather than passing silently.
_the_trap: 🔴🔴 THE FILE CALLED reg_lb8_final.pdf IS NOT THE ENACTED REGENTS PLAN. It was assembled on 2021-09-30, after LB 8 passed, and its sheets carry the date the GIS drew them: 2021-09-25. AM41 was filed AND ADOPTED on 2021-09-28 (Nebraska Legislature bill history for LB 8, DocumentID 46672), and LB 8 passed on Final Reading 46-2-1 on 2021-09-30. So the sheets in the 'final' bundle predate the amendment that passed, and four of the eight districts in it are wrong: it gives District 1 as 242,357 and District 4 as 234,292, against the enacted 248,649 and 237,525, with the differences traded to Districts 5 and 8. The enacted numbers are in reg_lb8_am41.pdf, and the State of Nebraska's own GIS agrees with it on all eight. ▶ A sheet titled 'Final Reading' can predate the amendment that passed. Read the date inside the map frame, not the file name, and check the bill history. And note that LB 8 adopts the plan by the map NAME (REG21-39003-1 … -8) — which AM41 did not change — so the statute cannot tell the two versions apart either.
